what: A screen-height panel is pinned (sticky) in the left half of the list section, and each row’s paired photo is stacked inside it — while a row’s top edge travels from 100px above the screen bottom to the screen center, that photo fills upward from its bottom edge (clip-path inset 100% → 0, scrub 1, power1.out) and covers the previous photo, and only the blurred background panel of the row crossing screen center turns on in .8s ease (scrolling back up restores the previous row’s background).

duration.Filling up: Cell top edge from screen bottom -100px → screen center (scrub 1)

options.scrub: Follow lag (s), default 1 — true binds immediately
options.ease: Fill-up curve, default power1.out (original gives no curve, so the GSAP default)
options.back-start: Start of the range where the background changes, default top center
options.back-end: End of the background-swap range, default bottom center
options.--fx-dur: Background change duration (set via style), default .8s
options.--fx-ease: Curve for the background change (via style), default ease
options.--fx-top: Position where the panel attaches (via style), default 0
options.--fx-photo-w: Photo width (via style), default 100% — 60% for Brand group
options.--fx-photo-h: Photo height (via style), default 100% — auto follows the photo cell ratio
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Sticky panel (child) — holds the photo and background inside
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos that fill up (inside the panel, one after another for the number of cells)
options.[data-fx-part=back]: (If present) Blurred background panel per cell (inside the panel) — the active one gets .is-active
options.[data-fx-part=item]: List cell (beside the board) — its order pairs with the photo and background order

note: The panel is sticky so it also sticks inside an inner scroll area (data-fx-scroller). On screens like phones that hide the panel and put a separate photo in each cell, set the panel to display:none — only the background change runs and nothing is visible
